preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 3000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1])
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 3000) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 if i == 0 else 0 <= int(x) <= 1000 for i, x in enumerate(line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains three integers n, k1, k2 (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000; 0 ≤ k1, k2 ≤ n) representing the board dimensions and white cell counts.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(0 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains two integers w, b (0 ≤ w, b ≤ n) representing the number of white and black dominoes.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive) indicating whether all dominoes can be placed.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda t, lines: any((lambda n, k1, k2, w, b: (w <= (k1 + k2) // 2) and (b <= (2 * n - k1 - k2) // 2))(*map(int, lines[i].split()), *map(int, lines[i+1].split())) for i in range(1, len(lines), 2)))(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]), stdin.splitlines()[1:])) == (stdout.strip().upper() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: The output 'YES' is correct if and only if the total number of white dominoes w does not exceed the maximum possible white dominoes (floor((k1 + k2) / 2)) and the total number of black dominoes b does not exceed the maximum possible black dominoes (floor((2 * n - k1 - k2) / 2)).
